pages.title: MICRO SCOOTERS Micro Scooter Plain Small Bike Helmet - Red
pages.description: Micro helmets are designed with solid ABS construction and EPS foam lining to for impact protection. They feature an LED rear light and reflective rear Micro logo so they can be seen and safe, while detailed with a protective chin pad for comfort. They’re made with a multi adjustable sizing wheel for the perfect fit alongside inner padding and easy squeeze buckleunbuckle so kids can do it themselves. The multiple air vents keep heads cool and adjustable straps allow the helmet to grow with them, while the shape covers more of the head and forehead for all-round protection.
